signals.title: The New Place Kids Are Chatting Online
signals.note: Kids route around social media bans by chatting inside a music app. Every ban opens a new margin.

signals.title: la tangente | algo está pasando con el folklore argentino
signals.note: Young Argentine listeners turning to folklore and crossing it with other genres. Tradition as the new edge.

signals.title: La economía agroecológica avanza en América: lecciones desde los movimientos
signals.note: Peasant, indigenous and cooperative groups from 15 countries certify their own food. Quality defined by producers, not certifiers.

signals.title: Ni extras, ni villanos: el cine villero que le da batalla cultural a las grandes producciones
signals.note: A film company from Villa 21-24 tells its own stories. The margin stops being an extra in someone else's film.

signals.title: Los jubilados lanzan una Iniciativa Popular para sancionar una nueva Ley que recomponga sus ingresos
signals.note: Retirees revive a direct-democracy tool almost nobody uses. When the usual channels close, dormant ones reopen.

signals.title: Fanfiction Isn’t Dead, But AO3 Might Be
signals.note: Readers organise to rescue fanfiction as its main archive weakens. A community becoming its own archive.

signals.title: Día Mundial de la Pesca | Dejar descansar el mar y reinventar la pesca, las apuestas de comunidades en América Latina
signals.note: Artisanal fishers in Mexico, Peru and Chile let the sea rest on their own terms. Setting limits before anyone imposes them.

signals.title: Un molino agroecológico en plena Pampa Húmeda y el cooperativismo que produce alimentos sanos
signals.note: An agroecological mill in Lincoln, in the middle of soy country, and it pays. The exception growing inside the model it questions.
